integrity: Exact finite-state definitions, analytical proof of asymptotics, and independent exhaustive graph calculations at small sizes are provided. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
limitations: The two-row periodic-longitudinal strip is not the full triangular lattice. Weak one-spin local minima need not be dynamically absorbing when zero-energy flips are allowed. Uniform local-minimum counts do not yield quench hitting probabilities. Prior exact enumeration outside indexed searches remains possible.
title: Exponential local metastability without strict freezing on a triangular Ising ladder
